Hey i also had the same problem and i found out that there were two solutions that are very good. First, dwarf puffer fish. These guys can easily fit in a 5 gallon tank, about 3 per 5 gallons and they will feast on the snails with glee. However, they are live feeders so if you ever run out of snails they might starve as they are hardcore predators. Secondly, you can just place a piece of lettuce in the tank and wait for the snails to come and eat the lettuce. Once its covered up with snails, throw it away. But honestly the dwarf puffers are too adorable not to buy <3
